w2:textbox.label: Upload to GridView after Rounding Decimal Points

1. Prepare an Excel file containing integers with more than three decimal places. (Or click the button below to download a sample file.)

(options.applyDecimal=“1” & options.decimal = “3”)
2-1. Click the first button and upload the Excel file.
2-2. Confirm that the file is uploaded to the GridView with values rounded to the third decimal place.

(options.applyDecimal=“0”)
3-1. Click the second button and upload the Excel file.
3-2. Confirm that the file is uploaded to the GridView without rounding.

/// Sample Code (1)

var options = {};
options.headerExist = "1";
options.decimal = "3";
options.applyDecimal = "1";
gridView1.advancedExcelUpload(options);

/// Sample Code (2)

var options = {};
options.headerExist = "1";
gridView1.advancedExcelUpload(options);
